outcome: Relationship between pre-second stage cesarean delivery rate, second stage cesarean delivery rate, and assisted vaginal birth rate
cohort: The study included 353,434 singleton cephalic presenting term pregnancies delivered in 8 public obstetrical units between 2009 and 2018.
finding: A bubble chart is a useful method for analyzing the interdependent relationship among pre-second stage cesarean delivery, second stage cesarean delivery, and assisted vaginal birth rates to differentiate obstetrical practice between different units.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women had a significantly lower pre-second stage cesarean delivery rate but higher second stage cesarean delivery and assisted vaginal birth rates compared to multiparous women, demonstrating the interconnectedness of these birth modes.
